name: Black River — Bradley A. Hammer Memorial Conservation Area to Coon Island Conservation Area
gaugeName: Black River at Poplar Bluff, MO (USGS 07063000)
blurb: Black River in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation and U.S. Forest Service accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Bradley A. Hammer Memorial Conservation Area
sections.notes: Put-in Bradley A. Hammer Memorial Conservation Area: exact agency access pin. Take-out Hendrickson Boat Launch: approximate area only. USACE Clearwater Lake (Little Rock District): Clearwater is "operated primarily for flood control", so Black River flow below the dam depends on dam operation. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
